paper_title: First results from the Axion Dark-Matter Birefringent Cavity (ADBC) experiment
notes: First results from ADBC birefringent optical cavity. Average 95% upper limit g_agamma <= 1.9e-8 GeV^-1 over five datasets covering ALP mass ranges 40.9-43.3, 49.3-50.6, and 54.4-56.7 neV/c^2 (Compton frequencies 9.88-13.69 MHz). The paper only quotes the average sensitivity value; individual per-mass limits vary but are not tabulated, so I encode the stated average sensitivity across the probed mass ranges. Local DM density 0.3 GeV/cm^3 assumed. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.7, 6))
